title: Three Mornings and One Short Line
subtitle: 语言文化 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 语言文化（人与社会·历史社会与文化·语言与文化）
meta: 主题语境：语言文化（人与社会·历史社会与文化·语言与文化）　|　核心词汇：idiom　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 idiom 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1993 the translator ① explained the idiom that no learner in the study would have described, and he said the explaining was the whole of the week. The ② idiom, meaning the phrase itself and not the line, ran three weeks and stayed undescribed in the book; a idiom, he said, is the only thing in a study that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ idiom in that study had the same short line beside it, and the ④ idiom at the far margin, meaning the proverb they kept for the children to copy and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A idiom, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the translator said the describing is the part that fills three weeks.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the idiom was the whole of the matter, meaning the culture and not the phrase. The ⑥ idiom, meaning the culture and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; idiom, he said, is either something you explain or the only word that means both a phrase and a culture. He said the culture is the part they remember.

By 1998 the ⑦ idiom had become a line in a glossary, and the glossary had become an argument about the short line. The ⑧ idiom of the whole thing, the translator wrote in April, was one study and three weeks of describing; idiom, he said, is either the proverb at the far margin or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ idiom I remember is the phrase described in the glossary, which closed in 2000 and is still described as the quietest in the study. A ⑩ idiom, my mother said in 2002, is the only phrase that improves by being described; every idiom, she said, is a culture that has agreed to look like a phrase. She said the culture was the honest half.

task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 习语；成语（指书房里每一条旁边的那一条）

F. n. 习语；成语（指词汇表里写到、被记下的的那一条）
G. n. 文化、意蕴（指一件事里人人都学却无人提起的那样东西）

idiom 意为“习语；成语”，指那条固定短语本身而不是一行，它经过了三个星期而在簿子上没有被描述。
idiom 意为“习语；成语”，指书房里每一条旁边的那一条，每一条旁边都有同一行短短的一行。
idiom 意为“习语；成语”，指最远那处页边留给孩子们抄的那一句那一条，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
idiom 意为“文化、意蕴”，指一件事里人人都学却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这层文化就是那件事的全部。
idiom 意为“意蕴”，指人人都学却无人提起的那样东西而不是那条固定短语，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
idiom 意为“习语；成语”，指词汇表里写到、被记下的的那一条，到 1998 年这一条成了词汇表里的一行。
idiom 意为“语汇之事”，译者四月写道，整件事的习语之事是一处书房和三个星期的描述。
